reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Istio CRDs are templated by default and can be installed and upgraded via `helm install istio-base`: This changes how CRDs are upgraded", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: The CRD upgrade procedure must change from kubectl apply -f manifests/charts/base/files/crd-all.gen.yaml to helm upgrade istio-base. CRD labels will be updated during the first helm upgrade command. Environments that previously used kubectl apply for CRD management must transition to Helm-based management.
consequence.remediation: Change CRD upgrade procedure from kubectl apply to helm upgrade istio-base command for all Helm-based Istio installations.

proposed.statement: Istio CRDs are now templated by default and managed via Helm; the recommended upgrade method changes from kubectl apply to helm upgrade istio-base, and CRD labels are updated to match Helm-installed resources.
